notes: LCR Meter (100 Hz - 100 kHz test signal)

transport._note: Protocol constants, not a per-model interface inventory. Which of these a box actually answers on is measured by the discovery sweep and recorded in the family probe file.

raw_socket.description: Bare SCPI over TCP. No session layer, no discovery.

hislip.description: IVI HiSLIP. Carries SRQ and device clear, unlike the raw socket.

vxi11.description: SUNRPC portmapper only; the core channel port is negotiated per session.

telnet.description: Human-facing SCPI prompt. Echoes and prints a banner — do not parse.

verb_mapping.get: Single-value queries (each one also a NAB)
verb_mapping.set: Single parameter mutation and write commands
verb_mapping.nab: Observation and telemetry acquisition queries — anything that returns more than one thing is a NAB only
verb_mapping.do: Zero-argument execution actions and trigger commands

Read_IDN.description: Queries the instrument identification (Manufacturer, Model, Serial, Firmware).

Learn_Settings.description: Reads the learn string: every current setting in one reply.

Get_Operation_Complete.description: Returns '1' once all pending operations are completed.

Self_Test.description: Runs the internal self-test; 0 = pass, else an error code.

Get_Init_Continuous.description: Reads whether continuous triggering is on.

Get_Measurement_Function.description: Reads what the meter is measuring.

Get_Test_Level.description: Reads the test signal voltage level.

Get_Error_Queue.description: Queries the next entry in the error queue.

Primary_Parameter.description: Selects the primary measurement parameter (Cp, Cs, Lp, Ls, R/G, |Z|/|Y|).

labels.REAL: R under impedance FIMP, G under admittance FADM

Primary_Parameter_CP.description: Primary_Parameter → CP (parallel capacitance). Selects the primary measurement parameter (Cp, Cs, Lp, Ls, R/G, |Z|/|Y|).

Primary_Parameter_CS.description: Primary_Parameter → CS (series capacitance). Selects the primary measurement parameter (Cp, Cs, Lp, Ls, R/G, |Z|/|Y|).

Primary_Parameter_LP.description: Primary_Parameter → LP (parallel inductance). Selects the primary measurement parameter (Cp, Cs, Lp, Ls, R/G, |Z|/|Y|).

Primary_Parameter_LS.description: Primary_Parameter → LS (series inductance). Selects the primary measurement parameter (Cp, Cs, Lp, Ls, R/G, |Z|/|Y|).

Primary_Parameter_MLIN.description: Primary_Parameter → MLIN (|Z| under FIMP, |Y| under FADM). Selects the primary measurement parameter (Cp, Cs, Lp, Ls, R/G, |Z|/|Y|).

Primary_Parameter_REAL.description: Primary_Parameter → REAL (R under impedance FIMP, G under admittance FADM). Selects the primary measurement parameter (Cp, Cs, Lp, Ls, R/G, |Z|/|Y|).

Limit_Lower.description: Sets the lower limit for the comparator.

Limit_State.description: Enables or disables the comparator function.

Limit_State_OFF.description: Limit_State → OFF. Enables or disables the comparator function.

Limit_State_ON.description: Limit_State → ON. Enables or disables the comparator function.

Limit_Upper.description: Sets the higher limit for the comparator.

Secondary_Parameter.description: Selects the secondary measurement parameter (e.g. D, Q, X, theta).

labels.IMAG: X under FIMP, B under FADM
labels.REAL: R under FIMP, G under FADM

Secondary_Parameter_D.description: Secondary_Parameter → D (dissipation factor). Selects the secondary measurement parameter (e.g. D, Q, X, theta).

Secondary_Parameter_IMAG.description: Secondary_Parameter → IMAG (X under FIMP, B under FADM). Selects the secondary measurement parameter (e.g. D, Q, X, theta).

Secondary_Parameter_PHAS.description: Secondary_Parameter → PHAS (θ). Selects the secondary measurement parameter (e.g. D, Q, X, theta).

Secondary_Parameter_Q.description: Secondary_Parameter → Q (quality factor). Selects the secondary measurement parameter (e.g. D, Q, X, theta).

Secondary_Parameter_REAL.description: Secondary_Parameter → REAL (R under FIMP, G under FADM). Selects the secondary measurement parameter (e.g. D, Q, X, theta).

Display_State.description: Turns the display ON or OFF.

Display_State_OFF.description: Display_State → OFF. Turns the display ON or OFF.

Display_State_ON.description: Display_State → ON. Turns the display ON or OFF.

Init_Continuous_OFF.description: Init_Continuous → OFF. Enables or disables continuous triggering.

Init_Continuous_ON.description: Init_Continuous → ON. Enables or disables continuous triggering.

Average_Count.description: Sets the number of measurement averages (1 to 256).

Voltage_Range_Auto.description: Turns impedance auto-ranging ON or OFF (OFF = hold range); the name is kept for the panels that bind it.

Voltage_Range_Auto_OFF.description: Voltage_Range_Auto → OFF. Turns impedance auto-ranging ON or OFF (OFF = hold range); the name is kept for the panels that bind it.

Voltage_Range_Auto_ON.description: Voltage_Range_Auto → ON. Turns impedance auto-ranging ON or OFF (OFF = hold range); the name is kept for the panels that bind it.

Current_Range.description: Sets the impedance measurement range in ohms (0.1 to 1M, or UP/DOWN); the name is kept for the panels that bind it.

Measurement_Function_FADM.description: Measurement_Function → "FADM" (admittance). Selects the measurement: impedance (FIMP) or admittance (FADM).

Measurement_Function_FIMP.description: Measurement_Function → "FIMP" (impedance). Selects the measurement: impedance (FIMP) or admittance (FADM).

Measurement_Function.description: Selects the measurement: impedance (FIMP) or admittance (FADM).

Set_Test_Frequency.description: Sets the test signal frequency (100, 120, 1k, 10k, 100k Hz).

Set_Bias_Voltage.description: Sets the internal DC bias voltage level.

Set_Bias_State.description: Turns the DC bias ON or OFF.

Set_Bias_State_OFF.description: Set_Bias_State → OFF. Turns the DC bias ON or OFF.

Set_Bias_State_ON.description: Set_Bias_State → ON. Turns the DC bias ON or OFF.

Set_Beeper.description: Turns the front-panel beeper ON or OFF.

Set_Beeper_OFF.description: Set_Beeper → OFF. Turns the front-panel beeper ON or OFF.

Set_Beeper_ON.description: Set_Beeper → ON. Turns the front-panel beeper ON or OFF.

Key_Lock.description: Locks or unlocks the front-panel keys.

Key_Lock_OFF.description: Key_Lock → OFF. Locks or unlocks the front-panel keys.

Key_Lock_ON.description: Key_Lock → ON. Locks or unlocks the front-panel keys.

Trigger_Delay.description: Sets the delay time before measurement starts.

Trigger_Source.description: Selects trigger source (INT, MAN, EXT, or BUS).

Trigger_Source_BUS.description: Trigger_Source → BUS (*TRG / GET). Selects trigger source (INT, MAN, EXT, or BUS).

Trigger_Source_EXT.description: Trigger_Source → EXT (rear trigger input). Selects trigger source (INT, MAN, EXT, or BUS).

Trigger_Source_INT.description: Trigger_Source → INT (free run). Selects trigger source (INT, MAN, EXT, or BUS).

Trigger_Source_MAN.description: Trigger_Source → MAN (front-panel key). Selects trigger source (INT, MAN, EXT, or BUS).

Read_IDN.description: Queries the instrument identification (Manufacturer, Model, Serial, Firmware).

Learn_Settings.description: Reads the learn string: every current setting in one reply.

Get_Operation_Complete.description: Returns '1' once all pending operations are completed.

Self_Test.description: Runs the internal self-test; 0 = pass, else an error code.

Get_Init_Continuous.description: Reads whether continuous triggering is on.

Get_Measurement_Function.description: Reads what the meter is measuring.

lcr_reading.description: What the meter is measuring, and its last measurement, together.

Get_Test_Level.description: Reads the test signal voltage level.

Get_Error_Queue.description: Queries the next entry in the error queue.

Measure_Reading.description: Triggers one measurement on the present setup (whatever the trigger source) and reads it: status, primary, secondary.

Nab_All_C.description: One C reading on the rigged setup: triggers and reads status, cp, d.

Nab_All_G.description: One G reading on the rigged setup: triggers and reads status, g, b.

Nab_All_L.description: One L reading on the rigged setup: triggers and reads status, ls, q.

Nab_All_R.description: One R reading on the rigged setup: triggers and reads status, r, x.

Nab_All_S.description: One S reading on the rigged setup: triggers and reads status, y, theta.

Nab_All_Z.description: One Z reading on the rigged setup: triggers and reads status, z, theta.

GRAB.description: GRAB — all 8 queries this model answered alone on the bench, stacked; the answers come back `;`-separated in the order of grab.commands

UTOPIA.description: UTOPIA — the pinnacle of simultaneous capture: the data this unit measures, 1 reading(s) (Measure_Reading), each asked for fresh and read, in one message

Rig_All_C.description: Sets the meter up to measure capacitance (parallel C and its D): bus trigger armed (continuous initiation on), test frequency (100, 120, 1k, 10k, 100k Hz) and level (V).

Rig_All_S.description: Sets the meter up to measure admittance in siemens (|Y| and its phase θ): bus trigger armed (continuous initiation on), test frequency (100, 120, 1k, 10k, 100k Hz) and level (V).

Rig_All_G.description: Sets the meter up to measure conductance (G and its susceptance B): bus trigger armed (continuous initiation on), test frequency (100, 120, 1k, 10k, 100k Hz) and level (V).

Rig_All_L.description: Sets the meter up to measure inductance (series L and its Q): bus trigger armed (continuous initiation on), test frequency (100, 120, 1k, 10k, 100k Hz) and level (V).

Rig_All_Z.description: Sets the meter up to measure impedance (|Z| and its phase θ): bus trigger armed (continuous initiation on), test frequency (100, 120, 1k, 10k, 100k Hz) and level (V).

Rig_All_R.description: Sets the meter up to measure resistance (R and its reactance X): bus trigger armed (continuous initiation on), test frequency (100, 120, 1k, 10k, 100k Hz) and level (V).

Clear_Status.description: Clears the status byte and error queue.

Reset_Device.description: Resets the unit to its factory default settings.

Trigger_Bus.description: Triggers the unit (equivalent to the Bus trigger).
